description: Yadulink helps you manage LinkedIn outreach from ChatGPT. Identify contacts to follow up with, review your pipeline and LinkedIn performance, summarize inbox conversations, prepare replies, qualify contact lists, and audit outreach sequences. You can also import contacts and create and launch sequences on selected lists after confirming the audience, messages, and timing. Requires a Yadulink account with active product access. LinkedIn searches and outreach require a connected LinkedIn account and remain subject to your account permissions and limits.

defaultPrompt: Tell me who I should contact today and why.
Summarize my LinkedIn inbox and draft three replies without sending them.
Audit my active outreach sequence and suggest the next improvement.
